name: Guitar Beginner Foundations
description: Teaches absolute beginners the first open chord shapes (G, C, D, Em, Am), correct finger placement with fret-hand diagrams, basic strumming patterns (all-downstroke, down-down-up, alternating bass), and a first-song chord progression sequence. Use when the user wants to start learning guitar, asks about beginner chords, first strumming patterns, or how to hold and fret a guitar. Do NOT use for intermediate barre chords or lead guitar techniques, music theory beyond basic chord names (use music-theory-fundamentals), or professional recording setup (use home-recording-starter).
